name: Everyday Care
summary: Rest, water, warm and cool tricks that work in every home.

remedies.name: Warm Salt-Water Gargle
remedies.howItHelps: Salt water pulls puffiness out of a swollen throat and washes germs away.
steps: Grown-up mixes half a spoon of salt in a cup of warm water.
Gargle, 'Gaa-gaa-gaa!', then spit it out.
Repeat 3 times a day.

remedies.name: Steam Breathing
remedies.howItHelps: Warm, wet air loosens the mucus so your nose and chest can clear.
steps: Grown-up fills a bowl with hot water.
Sit far enough away, cover your head with a towel.
Breathe slowly for a few minutes.
remedies.caution: Hot water! Only with a grown-up, and never lean too close.

remedies.name: Slow Sips of Water
remedies.howItHelps: Slow sips calm the jumpy diaphragm and refill a thirsty brain.
steps: Take ten tiny sips of water, one after another.
Breathe slowly through your nose.

remedies.name: Shade, Water & a Wet Cloth
remedies.howItHelps: Cooling down in the shade and drinking water brings your body temperature back down.
steps: Move to a cool, shady spot.
Sip water slowly.
Put a cool wet cloth on your neck and forehead.

remedies.name: Rinse & Tell a Grown-up
remedies.howItHelps: Rinsing removes stuck food. A grown-up can check if a dentist visit is needed.
steps: Swish warm water around your mouth.
Gently floss around the sore tooth.
Show a grown-up where it hurts.

remedies.name: Cold Compress
remedies.howItHelps: Cold makes the swelling and itch shrink, and calms a thumpy head.
steps: Wrap ice in a clean cloth (never ice straight on skin).
Hold it on the spot for a few minutes.

remedies.name: Rest & Gentle Stretches
remedies.howItHelps: Muscles repair themselves while you rest. Gentle stretches help blood bring them food.
steps: Lie down with your legs up on a pillow.
Do slow, gentle stretches. No bouncing!

remedies.name: Wash Face & Change Clothes
remedies.howItHelps: Pollen sticks to skin, hair and clothes. Washing it off means fewer sneezes.
steps: Wash your face and hands after playing outside.
Change into fresh clothes.
Keep windows closed on windy pollen days.

remedies.name: Fresh Air & Look Far Away
remedies.howItHelps: Looking at the far horizon helps your eyes and ears agree, and fresh air settles the tummy.
steps: Open the window a little.
Look far away, not at a book or screen.
Take slow, deep breaths.

remedies.name: Water, Fruit & a Walk
remedies.howItHelps: Water softens, fruit fiber sweeps, and walking wakes up a lazy tummy.
steps: Drink a big glass of water.
Eat a fruit like papaya or guava.
Go for a short walk.

remedies.name: Warm Water Bottle & Rest
remedies.howItHelps: Gentle warmth relaxes tight tummy muscles.
steps: Grown-up fills a bottle with warm (not hot!) water.
Lie down and rest it on your tummy.
remedies.caution: Make sure it's warm, not hot.
